mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.status, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues i WHERE i.project_id = p.id AND i.status != 'closed') AS open_issue_count FROM projects p ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (name, status, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
